name: @localai/ui
description: Shared UI package of the Local AI lab: the node card and status chips (CLOUD-11), the generated agent API types, the music studio, song library and workload switcher (E11), and the desktop shell later (DSK-01). Props are plain data and transports; the components fetch nothing themselves. React, MUI and the MUI icons come from the host app (no peerDependencies are declared: this package is also installed standalone by agent.yml to check the generated types). React is a devDependency only for the component tests and the standalone typecheck of the MUI-free parts.
